toegepas.na: Die prent van 'n uil was so 'n teken
toegepas.rede_vinder: The sign was a picture of an owl, not the owl itself.
toegepas.fout: 'Die uil' says the owl itself was a sign, with no antecedent; the sign was a picture of an owl.
toegepas.rede_keurder: More exact and consistent with 'prente en simbole' in the first sentence, without adding a fact or touching a protected word.

toegepas.voor: het jare lank leer lees en skryf en daarna rekords van oeste en belasting gehou
toegepas.na: het jare lank geleer om te lees en te skryf. Daarna het hulle rekords van oeste en belasting gehou
toegepas.rede_vinder: The chain of two 'en' joins with a bare 'leer lees en skryf' is hard to parse at Grade 5; two sentences read more clearly.
toegepas.fout: One sentence chains three 'en' joins with a long middle field before 'gehou', which makes a Grade 5 reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two sentences are easier to read, 'hulle' clearly refers to the skrifgeleerdes, and the people, actions and order are unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Elke' together with 'dikwels' is contradictory (every flood often); the plural keeps the meaning without the clash.
toegepas.fout: 'Elke oorstroming ... dikwels' is self-contradictory (every flood often).
toegepas.rede_keurder: The plural removes the clash while keeping the qualifier 'dikwels' and the meaning intact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Merke tussen lande' is vague; 'grensmerke' names the boundary markers plainly.
toegepas.fout: 'Merke' is vague about what kind of marks were washed away.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Grensmerke' names the boundary markers plainly and is the more exact word, with no new fact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Nog' and 'ekstra' say the same thing twice.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Dropping the redundant 'nog' is cleaner and the count and meaning are unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Die son se skaduwee het deur die dag geskuif
toegepas.na: Die skaduwee op die sonwyser het deur die dag geskuif
toegepas.rede_vinder: The sun does not have a shadow; the shadow is the one the sun casts on the sundial.
toegepas.fout: 'Die son se skaduwee' says the sun has a shadow, which is imprecise.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The shadow on the sundial is what moved and showed the time; this fixes the imprecision without a new fact, and the protected 'sonwysers' in the previous sentence stays intact.

laat_vaar.voor: Papirus is gemaak van 'n plant wat soos riet langs die Nyl groei
laat_vaar.na: Papirus is van 'n plant gemaak wat soos riet langs die Nyl groei
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The past participle belongs before the relative clause in standard Afrikaans word order; the protected wording stays intact.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original order is natural Afrikaans, and moving 'gemaak' splits the protected wording ''n plant wat soos riet', so the protected string no longer stands intact.

laat_vaar.voor: Die Egiptenare het in hul sterrekunde die son, maan en sterre fyn dopgehou.
laat_vaar.na: Die Egiptenare het die son, maan en sterre fyn dopgehou en so aan sterrekunde gedoen.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'In hul sterrekunde ... dopgehou' is wooden; 'aan sterrekunde doen' is the natural idiom and keeps the term and protected wording.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The proposal is longer and recasts astronomy as a consequence of watching the sky ('en so'), which shifts the relation rather than only smoothing it.

laat_vaar.voor: om die tyd in die dag te meet
laat_vaar.na: om die tyd van die dag te meet
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The idiomatic phrase is 'die tyd van die dag'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The preposition swap changes meaning: 'in die dag' also carries 'during daytime' (true of sundials) and matches the block heading, while 'van die dag' keeps only 'time of day'.

na_skrywer.voor: wat met 'n skaduwee van die son die tyd wys
na_skrywer.na: wat die tyd wys met die skaduwee wat die son gooi
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'n Skaduwee van die son' is unclear and the long middle field is awkward; this says plainly whose shadow and what it shows.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Met 'n skaduwee van die son' is unclear about whose shadow it is, the same fault as in change 9.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but this rewords a glossary definition beyond a spelling or grammar fix, so the writer must change it for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.rede: The block heading uses 'die tyd in die dag'; the idiomatic form is 'die tyd van die dag'. A script cannot change a heading, so if the body change is kept the writer may want to align the heading.
